about_the_game:
Your sister's death left you a ghost, consumed by guilt for being weak. But through the static of a radio, a voice emerges: "Attention! All survivors... there is a safe base to the north..."

Suddenly, there's a goal. A chance. With your only gun in hand, a decision is made. Why not?

Get ready for a brutal and bloody shooter adventure. One Man: alone against everyone! One Gun: absurd firepower that needs no ammo! One Thousand Zombies: a horde of hungry, walking flesh, ready to make you their dinner!

Logic doesn't matter here. Destroy everything and everyone in your path.

Shoot first, shoot always!

Key Features:

  • Frenetic and Brutal Action: Fight against hordes of zombies while trying not to be devoured by the hungry dead!

  • The Only Gun You Need: Wield an immensely powerful weapon capable of obliterating hordes of zombies with a single bullet—and it never needs ammo!

  • Relentless Survival: Once they see you, they never stop hunting you. Use your agility to stay one step ahead of the apocalypse.

  • Destroy Everything: The environment is your playground. Blow up walls, annihilate obstacles, and enjoy the chaos as you turn the world to ash.

The path to the safe base is long and covered with the dead. Fight, destroy, and survive.

Add One Man! One Gun! One Thousand Zombies! to your Wishlist now!

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains frequent violence, blood, and gore depicted in a pixel art style. Players use a firearm to engage in intense combat against large numbers of zombies and other human survivors.

The game also features mature themes, including a protagonist with a cynical and violent worldview, occasional strong language (swearing), and moments of psychological horror with unsettling, unkillable enemies. Player discretion is advised.```

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.0 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 10 compatible graphics card
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatible sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit) or newer
  • Processor: Quad Core 2.5 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible graphics card with 1 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended

short_description: A minimalist, brutal, and bloody side-scrolling shooter. No more boredom: we give you an overpowered gun to obliterate hordes of zombies with a single shot. Pure action and instant carnage.
